prompt: How many solutions does the equation $8(9x - 6) = -12(4 - 6x)$ have?
explanation: Choice D is correct. Applying the distributive property to each side of the given equation yields $72x - 48 = -48 + 72x$. Applying the commutative property of addition to the right-hand side of this equation yields $72x - 48 = 72x - 48$. Since the two sides of the equation are equivalent, this equation is true for any value of $x$. Therefore, the given equation has infinitely many solutions.
